details.heading: From Being Overlooked to a Big Achievement:
details.description: When Swarnasikha Behera began her career journey, finding the right opportunity was not easy. Like many aspiring professionals, she faced moments when her skills and potential did not receive the recognition she hoped for.
details.heroImageAlt: Swarnasikha Behera - Technical Support at Tech Mahindra

columns.title: The Journey & Aspirations
paragraphs: When Swarnasikha Behera began her career journey, finding the right opportunity was not easy. Like many aspiring professionals, she faced moments when her skills and potential did not receive the recognition she hoped for.
However, instead of allowing those experiences to hold her back, she continued working on herself and looking for the right opportunity to prove her capabilities.

columns.title: Preparation & Shortlisted Program
paragraphs: Through HireKarma’s Shortlisted Program, Swarnasikha found a structured platform designed to help aspiring professionals become industry-ready.

From skill assessments and preparation activities to personalized guidance and employer interactions, the program helped her understand her strengths, improve her professional readiness, and gain valuable exposure to real-world recruitment processes.

With consistent effort and the right guidance, Swarnasikha began approaching career opportunities with greater confidence. The preparation she received helped her recognize her abilities and present her skills more effectively to recruiters.

columns.title: Placement & Impact
paragraphs: Her dedication and determination, combined with the support of the Shortlisted Program, ultimately led to a significant career achievement—her successful placement in Technical Support at Tech Mahindra.

Starting her professional journey in Technical Support at Tech Mahindra gives Swarnasikha the opportunity to gain valuable industry exposure, strengthen her technical and problem-solving abilities, and build confidence in a professional IT environment.

At HireKarma, stories like Swarnasikha’s represent the purpose of the Shortlisted Program—to help talented candidates recognize their potential, prepare for real-world opportunities, connect with relevant employers, and take meaningful steps toward their career goals.

details.quote: My experience with the Shortlisted Program helped me understand my strengths and approach the recruitment process with much more confidence. The guidance, preparation, and opportunities provided through the program helped me improve my professional skills and believe more strongly in my potential. I am grateful to HireKarma for supporting me throughout my journey and helping me achieve this important milestone in my career at Tech Mahindra.

details.description: Every career begins with a moment when a person decides to believe in their own potential. For Sahil Kumar Sahoo, that moment came when he chose to turn uncertainty into action and actively work toward building a professional future.
details.heroImageAlt: Sahil Kumar Sahoo - Technical Support at Tech Mahindra

columns.title: The Journey & Aspirations
paragraphs: Every career begins with a moment when a person decides to believe in their own potential. For Sahil Kumar Sahoo, that moment came when he chose to turn uncertainty into action and actively work toward building a professional future.

Instead of waiting for the perfect opportunity, Sahil focused on becoming better prepared for the opportunities that came his way. He understood that getting selected was not only about having the right qualifications—it was also about having the confidence, communication, preparation, and professional mindset needed to succeed in a competitive recruitment environment.

columns.title: Preparation & Shortlisted Program
paragraphs: HireKarma’s Shortlisted Program became an important part of this journey. Through structured preparation, skill evaluation, career guidance, and opportunities to interact with employers, Sahil gained a clearer understanding of what it takes to enter the professional world.

Each stage of the process helped him become more confident. He learned how to present his abilities, approach recruitment conversations with a positive mindset, and recognize the value of the skills he had developed.

columns.title: Placement & Impact
paragraphs: That preparation eventually turned into a major milestone when Sahil Kumar Sahoo was successfully selected for a Technical Support role at Tech Mahindra.

His new role in Technical Support at Tech Mahindra will give him the opportunity to work in a professional technology environment, develop his troubleshooting and communication abilities, understand real-world technical challenges, and gain valuable experience working with customers and technology solutions.

At HireKarma, Sahil’s journey reflects an important belief: sometimes, the difference between having potential and achieving something meaningful is having the right preparation and the right opportunity at the right time.

details.quote: The Shortlisted Program gave me a better understanding of how to prepare myself for professional opportunities. The guidance and preparation helped me become more confident in presenting my skills and facing the recruitment process. Being selected at Tech Mahindra is a very important milestone for me, and I am thankful to HireKarma for helping me move closer to my career goals.
